speaker: customer
text: My friend said I will get twelve percent guaranteed, right?

speaker: agent
text: I have to stop you there — no. This is market-linked. Twelve percent is possible; zero years happen too. Nobody can guarantee it, and anyone who does is misleading you.

speaker: customer
text: Oh. Then why would I take it at all?

speaker: agent
text: Long horizon, tax benefit, and life cover — but only if you are comfortable with the ups and downs. If you want guaranteed, I would honestly point you to a different product.

speaker: customer
text: You are the first agent who has said that to me.

speaker: agent
text: That is the only way I work. Let us figure out which one actually fits you.
